PENALTY COMPUTATION EXAMPLE

Part II: The underpayment of estimated tax shall be computed as follows: The number of days from the due date of the quarterly payment
         to the date payment is actually made divided by 365, times ten percent (10%), times the amount of underpayment.

                     Line 1            Tax Liability                              $5,000
                     Line 2            90% of Tax Liability                       $4,500
                     Line 3            Payments                                   $2,000
                     Line 4            Line (1) less Line (3)                     $3,000
                     Line 5            Prior Year Tax Liability                   $3,000
                     Line 6            Required Annual Payment                    $3,000
                                       [Lesser of (2) or (5)]
Note:       Payments reported on Line (3) shall be deemed to have been paid in four (4) equal payments on the quarterly due dates.



Part III:            Required Installments ...................... $3,000 divided by 4 = $750
                     Payments......................................... $2,000 divided by 4 = $500

                     Column (a)         4-15-2025         Required Installment             $750
                                                          Payment 4-15-2025                $500
                                                          Underpayment                     $250
                                                          Paid 6-15-2025                  ($250)
                                                                                             -0-
                                                          4-15-2025 to 6-15-2025 = 61 days
                                                          61/365 X .10 X $250 = $4                           First Quarter Penalty...........$ 4

                     Column (b)         6-15-2025         Required Installment                      $750
                                                          Payment 6-15-2025              $500
                                                          Used 4-15-2025                ($250)
                                                                                          ($250)
                                                          Underpayment                     $500
                                                          Paid 9-15-2025                  ($500)
                                                                                            -0-
                                                          6-15-2025 to 9-15-2025 = 92 days
                                                          92/365 X .10 x $500 = $13                          Second Quarter Penalty......$13

                     Column (c)         9-15-2025         Required Installment                      $750
                                                          Payment 9-15-2025              $500
                                                          Used 6-15-2025                ($500)         -0-
                                                          Underpayment                              ($750)
                                                          Paid 1-15-2026                $500
                                                          Paid 4-15-2026                $250
                                                                                          ($750)
                                                                                            -0-
                                                          9-15-2025 to 1-15-2026 = 122 days
                                                          122/365 X .10 X $500 = $17
                                                          9-15-2025 to 4-15-2026 = 212 days
                                                          212/365 X .10 X $250 = $15                         Third Quarter Penalty..........$32

                     Column (d)         1-15-2026         Required Installment                      $750
                                                          Payment                        $500
                                                          Used 9-15-2025                ($500)
                                                                                             -0-
                                                          Underpayment                     $750
                                                          Paid 4-15-2026                  ($750)
                                                                                            -0-
                                                          1-15-2026 to 4-15-2026 = 90 days
                                                          90/365 X .10 x $750 = $18                          Fourth Quarter Penalty........$18



                                                                                                             Total Penalty......................$67
